_comment: app/intake/connector_catalogue.json — F42-I04: the brand onboarding's connector registry (step 接工具). One row per connector: what the system can read once it is connected (`reads`). `live` = the system can connect it today; every other row is a seat (「即將開放」). Per-brand state (Meta bound or not) is computed by app/intake/onboarding.py, not stored here. Same idea as app/schedule/channel_catalogue.json: adding GA4 / a shop platform / MCP is one more row, not a new screen.
